parameters.vote: strict majority of eligible models per voxel
parameters.tie_rule: winner map: equal votes go to the lower instance index (cranial); such voxels are never consensus and are counted in conflict_voxels

eligibility.skellytour: body crop i 0:512 j 79:391 (plan.json); no sacrum class

hra_same_donor_evidence.source: HRA united-female v1.5 (public/atlases/hra-female.json), modelled on the Visible Human Female; NIH 3D 3DPX-020988: "The Visible Human Female has 6 lumbar vertebrae"
hra_same_donor_evidence.transform: hra-stage-to-vhf (similarity on six organ proxies, RMS 7.4 mm) then inverse denver-image-to-stage; positions are approximate, the order and count are the evidence
hra_same_donor_evidence.reading: Same count as the HRA female skeleton: the by-order names are a candidate numbering with same-donor external support, pending anatomist confirmation.

naming: Every instance id is provisional and geometric. hra_name_by_order is external same-donor evidence for the count and order, not a decision; name_status stays pending until an anatomist or a documented reference confirms the levels.
